title.zh: 共同实现测试下的目标唯一性

statement.en: Where tests that include holding two parts together tell apart the configurations of a target frame, a configuration of any source frame passes the same tests as at most one target configuration.
statement.zh: 凡含“共同持有两部分”的测试区分目标框架的构形，任一源框架的构形至多与一个目标构形通过相同测试。

laws.en: A test with parts is nothing, a claim, the failure of a test, two tests together, that some step by a move leads to where a test holds, or that the configuration holds together, under one relation of a family, two parts passing two tests. A joint frame is a frame with one such relation, a configuration realizing two configurations together as its parts; no associativity, order, unit or repetition of parts is assumed.
laws.zh: 带部分的测试是：无、一个主张、一个测试的失败、两个测试同时、某步经某动作通往测试成立处，或该构形在一族关系之一下共同持有分别通过两个测试的两部分。共同框架是带一个这样关系的框架：一个构形共同实现两个构形作为其部分；不假设部分的结合律、次序、单位或重复。

laws.en: For any two frames, each with a family of relations by which a configuration holds two parts together: where the tests with parts tell apart the configurations of the target (any two of them passing the same tests are equal), a configuration of the source passes the same tests with parts as at most one target configuration. Joint tests are the case of the one relation of a joint frame.
laws.zh: 对任意两个框架，各带一族“一个构形共同持有两部分”的关系：凡带部分的测试区分目标的构形（通过相同测试的任两个相等），源的一个构形至多与一个目标构形通过相同的带部分测试。共同测试是共同框架那一个关系的情形。

hypotheses.en: Any two frames of the spine with the same moves and claims and with relations among configurations (for joint tests, the one relation of a joint frame); the target is separated: two of its configurations passing the same tests with parts are equal.
hypotheses.zh: 脊柱上任意两个有相同动作与主张、带构形间关系的框架（共同测试时为共同框架的那一个关系）；目标被分离：其通过相同带部分测试的两个构形相等。

does_not_show.en: Uniqueness of the matching target does not by itself recover joint plans or license substituting one designated part for another.
does_not_show.zh: 匹配目标的唯一性本身不恢复共同计划，也不允许以一个指定部分替换另一个。

does_not_show.en: It does not settle whether two designated parts draw on the same support.
does_not_show.zh: 它不判定两个指定部分是否用同一支持。

next_delta.en: Give the correspondence by which, in an application of the joint tests, designated parts can be substituted for one another or joint realization read as concurrency over time.
next_delta.zh: 给出在共同测试的应用中可互换指定部分、或把共同实现读作随时间之并发所需的对应。

correspondence.zh: together 检验整体的成对共同实现；不把分别成立当成共同实现。
correspondence.en: The together test concerns joint realization of a pair within a whole; separate truth is not joint realization.

detail.zh: 保留不同测试语义，不按相同声明外形合并。
detail.en: Retain distinct test semantics rather than merging by header shape.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。联合检验区分框架之配置处，一配置至多与其中一者通过相同联合检验（SameJointTests.functional）；same_target_unique 即此定律在模型框架上（same_target_unique_by_core），无附加假设，公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明、其回执与共享支持的反例保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. Where joint tests tell a frame's configurations apart, a configuration passes the same joint tests as at most one of them (SameJointTests.functional); same_target_unique is that law on the model's frame (same_target_unique_by_core), with no added hypothesis and empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof, its receipt and the shared-support counterexample keep their scope.
